name: advanced-tictactoe
description: Real-time multiplayer Advanced Tic-Tac-Toe (Gobblet Junior) with a 2.5D isometric board

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c red,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
